digest.title: Heart of the Matter: How a Major Children’s Hospital Uses Open Source NVIDIA AI for Cardiac Care
Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
digest.tldr: Salesforce Koa is built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model and is trained to do sales, marketing and customer-support tasks.

digest.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
digest.tldr: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.

digest.title: Microsoft releases emergency Windows updates to fix RDS failures
digest.tldr: Microsoft has released emergency out-of-band Windows updates to fix Remote Desktop Services failures caused by this month's security updates, along with Hyper-V and USB audio problems on some Windows versions.

digest.title: Microsoft confirms KB5002914 Excel update breaks copy and paste
digest.tldr: Microsoft has confirmed that copy and paste may silently fail for some Excel users after installing the September 2026 KB5002914 security update.
